surfaces.mechanism: A reason-carrying atom is diverted before any claim branch by `mapWarmVerifyDeclineEnvelope` (non-empty reason -> decline; with a setback table present it serves status "ok" + the real scalars + a disclosure naming the reason). A reasonless atom falls to the P-249 `envelope-unverified` branch: status "ok", `figureWithheld: true`, NO figure, NO `emptyReason`.
surfaces.residual: A PROMOTED reasonless atom reaches the claim branch at `outcomeKind === "no-buildable-area" && depthWarm` and is served `buildableAreaPct: 0` + the sentence. Measured membership in the cohort: 0.
